message: Last month, we had an unexpected blackout right when I was about to video call my sister for a much-needed catch-up. My phone was at 15%, and I realized I hadn’t charged my power bank in ages. 😅 I grabbed my trusty flashlight, found a cozy spot with some snacks, and made the most of it while I charged everything up. It turned out to be a great excuse for a tech break! Now I keep my power bank charged and handy—just in case. What’s your go-to strategy for keeping the lights on during an outage?
